O_STUDY_COMPLETE records repackedAfterStudy true and retains it through final state.
S1 is unburdened and has 60-ft speed at creation.
Mounting the 170-lb / 7-Load rider payload makes S1 burdened at 50-ft speed.
The command clears at attempt start while full command receipt and spent owner Bonus Action, Steed Action, and crossing use remain recorded.
Every later attached phase defaults to Dodge with no pending crossing command.
Dismount restores S1's unburdened 60-ft state.
Mounted burden and speed persist through every intermediate state until dismount.
Dispatch all 11 C and 11 O regular START markers.
Dispatch 11 C and 10 O END markers; O has no END after expiry at START 62.
Dispatch every S1 attached phase while its original application is active.
Destination mount's farthest occupied corner 9.273618 ft is inside the conservative clear radius 9.916667 ft.
Destination rider/cargo envelope's farthest occupied corner 8.200610 ft is inside the conservative clear radius 9.916667 ft.
C's nearest occupied point is 30.858548 ft from center and outside the shell.
The Sphere shell is above ground and does not intersect the declared floor.
C-to-center distance 36.055513 ft is within the 120-ft native range.
O perceives clear S1 creation space within the Steed's 60-ft range.
The manifested shell had no body/solid intersection; its expiry did not affect the ground or other scene geometry.
C pays 26 RP and O pays 5 RP once; neither payment is refunded.
Both separate first-family casts use only the stated protection; Dissonance and Refrain remain zero.
C completes the source-bound 45-minute 24-entry ordinary preparation with Sphere prepared.
Both source book-access operations and repacks are recorded before paid casts without double-counting cargo.
Each paid cast has exact V/S/F, accessible focus, free somatic hand, custody, and prior book repack recorded.
Rider and all declared gear fit the exact capacity and burden calculation.
S1 spends its Action and sole crossing attempt before the Sphere-caused denial.
The group remains at origin through denial; O later dismounts legally, retaining all gear custody.
Sphere and Steed expire at their original independent deadlines.
No automatic retry, corpse, loot, deletion, teleport, or additional resource trigger is created.
Both original concentration effects close only at their stated endpoints.
Packet records no parent/canon/fixture/queue mutation, no acceptance/application, and no seal.
Director request explicitly preserves all unrelated authority and holds.
